name: ads-frame-audit
description: Deterministic frame-by-frame QA audit of the superbot-ads animations (this repo's tools/audit.mjs): steps the ad loop with a virtual rAF clock in headless Chromium, samples at --fps, and runs layout invariants — odometer digit alignment + rendered value vs spec at rest, text-block overlaps, typewriter completeness vs exact strings, chart lines finishing before the cut, offstage clipping during wide shots — plus screenshots at beats. Reach for it after ANY change to assets/ad.js, ad.css, index.html or player.html. Exit: returns violations[] (empty = clean); also proves fault-detection, not just green passes.
